rounds.text: Ravelcare Ltd is severely under-appreciated by the market, trading at an inexpensive P/E of 12.8 [E1] that sits well below the sector benchmark P/E of 18.01x [E6]. This valuation disconnect occurs despite extraordinary operational profitability, highlighted by a commanding ROCE of 30.5% [E12] and an ROE of 22.2% [E13]. The company's exceptional compounding ability is further demonstrated by a stellar 3-year median ROE of 45% [E19] and a strong historical 3-year ROE track record of 44.8% [E42]. Even on asset efficiency, the business significantly outperforms its peers, generating an ROA of 13.74% against a sector benchmark of just 4.63% [E8]. Conceded: [E4]. Conceded: [E5].

The market price of ₹ 99.0 sits just 3% of the way up the 52-week range against a previous high of ₹ 215, reflecting a severe collapse in market confidence [E2, E5]. This catastrophic share price erosion occurs despite a market capitalisation of only ₹ 67.9 Cr [E3]. Furthermore, the company offers a dividend yield of exactly 0.00%, depriving shareholders of any cash return while they sit on depressed capital [E4]. Conceded: the reported trailing ROE of 13.78% to 22.2% and the ROCE of 30.5% outperform certain sector benchmarks [E8, E9, E12, E13]. However, the median return on equity has halved from a 3-year level of 45% down to 22% over the last year, exposing a sharp and worrying deterioration in underlying capital efficiency [E19, E20].

Conceded: the dividend yield is 0.00% [E4]. However, the narrative of a catastrophic collapse ignores that the P/E of 12.8x is deeply discounted against the sector benchmark of 18.01x, offering extraordinary value at a market capitalization of ₹ 67.9 Cr [E1, E3, E6]. While the 3-year median ROE of 45% moderated, the latest ROE figures of 13.78% to 22.2% alongside an elite ROCE of 30.5% demonstrate that the business remains an exceptional compounder of capital [E9, E12, E13, E19, E20, E42]. Furthermore, the company's ROA of 13.74% massively outperforms the sector benchmark of 4.63%, proving that operational asset efficiency is extraordinarily high [E8]. Far from a broken equity, the depressed price sitting at 3% of its range provides an entry point into a fundamentally robust cash-generative engine trading at a wide valuation margin [E1, E2, E5].

Conceded: the company records a ROCE of 30.5% and an ROA of 13.74% that outperforms the sector benchmark of 4.63% [E8, E12]. However, the bull's reliance on historical returns such as the 3-year median ROE of 45% masks a severe structural moderation, as the latest ROE has collapsed by more than half to 13.78% [E9, E19]. This downward trajectory is further confirmed by the drop to a 22% ROE level, showing that past high compounding is fading rapidly [E13, E20, E42]. The assertion that a P/E of 12.8x offers extraordinary value ignores the glaring reality that the stock sits at a mere 3% of its 52-week range, reflecting profound market rejection rather than a mere discount [E1, E3, E5]. Furthermore, quoting a sector P/E discount of 13.34x against 18.01x provides no protection when the company offers a zero dividend yield of 0.00%, depriving shareholders of any cash return while the equity stagnates near its yearly low [E4, E5, E6].
